learning_outcomes.text: Students know electrical equipment such as DC machines, asynchronous machines, synchronous machines, and transformers, as well as their properties and possible applications.
Students are able to collect, evaluate, and interpret relevant information and derive scientifically sound judgments from it.
Students acquire the ability to argumentatively defend subject-specific positions and problem solutions.
Students can independently convert components into equivalent circuit diagrams and are able to interpret their electrical behavior.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, historical development, requirements, energy converters and energy transformers, energy conversion with power converters, basic equations of electric drives, torque characteristics of working machines
assessment_rules: The module grade is based on a 30-minute oral examination, which accounts for 100% of the module grade.
